raw.query: WITH initial AS (SELECT image_px,n_images,mean_ms,sm_clock_mhz FROM provenance.collector_fn WHERE source_path='/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseB_batch_validation/measured_f_n.csv' AND mean_ms IS NOT NULL), final AS (SELECT image_px,n_images,mean_ms,sm_clock_mhz FROM provenance.collector_fn WHERE source_path='/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseB_batch_validation/measured_f_n_5x50.csv' AND mean_ms IS NOT NULL), pairs AS (SELECT i.image_px,i.n_images,i.mean_ms initial_mean_ms,f.mean_ms final_mean_ms,i.sm_clock_mhz initial_clock_mhz,f.sm_clock_mhz final_clock_mhz,100*(f.mean_ms/i.mean_ms-1) AS initial_faster_pct FROM initial i JOIN final f USING(image_px,n_images)) SELECT image_px,n_images,initial_mean_ms,final_mean_ms,initial_clock_mhz,final_clock_mhz,initial_faster_pct,AVG(initial_faster_pct) OVER () AS mean_pct,MIN(initial_faster_pct) OVER () AS min_pct,MAX(initial_faster_pct) OVER () AS max_pct,COUNT(*) OVER () AS denominator_pairs FROM pairs ORDER BY image_px,n_images;
raw.observed: Across 8 matched configurations, the initial collection averaged 0.20692819648370775% faster; individual differences ranged from -0.14151352459339517% to 0.8749218819748217%, with measured clocks of 2385-2400 MHz rather than a materially higher unlocked-clock regime.
raw.evidence: The matched initial/final latency comparison is near parity at every configuration and does not support either the 17% magnitude or its attribution to unlocked clocks.
